description.value: Marugame Udon is a globally established Japanese fast-casual chain originating in Kagawa Prefecture, Japan, bringing its open-kitchen tradition of handcrafted Sanuki udon noodles and freshly-fried tempura to downtown Vancouver. Guests order at a counter and can watch their bowls assembled in a lively open kitchen before choosing from udon, rice dishes, and add-on tempura items. The Vancouver location sits near BC Place and Rogers Arena in the heart of the downtown core.
